offline_math.security: nonpersistent WebKit store, allowlisted bundled custom scheme, CSP, escaped imported text, trust:false, per-formula bounded macro expansion

targeted_formula_reader.scope: final changed-source tests: mixed inline/display/bare math and Chinese emphasis, injection/currency/prose exclusion, bundled assets, actual WebKit typesetting, horizontal overflow containment, permanent scroller synchronization, end-marker reachability and resize

graphical_formula_fixture.scope: isolated synthetic formula view: drag native scrollbar 0 to 1, visible end marker, wheel scroll, wide-equation scrollbar, raw source disclosure, expanded reading sheet, Page Down and Escape; compact layout reinspection after adaptive menus. These were development fixture observations, not the mounted production app.

source_panel_graphical_inspection.reason: Native UI inspection pipe closed before a readable source-panel state was returned; fixture app process remained running. Not counted as PASS.

release_xcode_build.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project LatticeLens.xcodeproj -scheme LatticeLens -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=macOS -derivedDataPath .codex-task-tmp-math-layout/DerivedData ARCHS='arm64 x86_64' ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT=dwarf-with-dsym SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=YES SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY=complete build
release_xcode_build.scope: clean working-tree source-bound universal Release, warnings-as-errors, matching executable and dSYM UUIDs

mounted_dmg_inspection.scope: read-only mount: image checksum, strict ad-hoc signature, byte-identical staged/mounted app, exact version/build and architectures; bundled math resources identical to source

installed_app_and_live_provider.scope: Installed 1.0.9 was still running at packaging; it was not overwritten or inspected through its library. No real provider, Keychain, Application Support library, research/PDF cache or INSPIRE access.
